profiles_by_preset.master: Final-year (8th Semester) Electronics, Communication and Information Engineering student at IOE, Kathmandu Engineering College, building applied ML systems, AI workflow tooling, and embedded ML software. Fuse AI Fellow (Fusemachines) and NSSR DataCamp Fellow. I use AI where it adds value, turn repeatable work into reusable tools, and verify results with tests and explicit evaluation. Work spans demographic fairness auditing, multi-provider agent coordination, Model Context Protocol (MCP) infrastructure, edge ML inference on ESP32-S3, near-memory ingress simulation, and native Windows systems utilities.
profiles_by_preset.research: Final-year Electronics, Communication and Information Engineering undergraduate focusing on applied AI fairness auditing, empirical model evaluation, and near-memory systems research. Fuse AI Fellow co-developing diagnostic prediction-auditing frameworks measuring canonical demographic parity and error-rate disparities across intersectional cohorts (AIF360, Fairlearn), alongside SimPy discrete-event modeling of ingress processing architectures and edge classifier validation on wearable IMU benchmarks.
profiles_by_preset.systems: Final-year Electronics, Communication and Information Engineering undergraduate building embedded ML software, control firmware, desktop systems utilities, and zero-cloud transport tools. ML and gateway lead for SPARK (ESP32-S3 wearable fall detection combining kinematic gating with an 18.5 KB INT8 CNN under FreeRTOS), developer of Win-Governor, Win-Vault, and Headless LocalSend Substrate. Experienced in C/C++, TFLite Micro, Win32/NTFS APIs, and deterministic verification.

fellowships.title: Fuse AI Fellow
fellowships.summary: Selected through the Fusemachines AI Fellowship entrance process; completed applied ML, CV, NLP, agentic AI, and MLOps coursework alongside the BiasAperture capstone.

bullets.text: Co-developed **BiasAperture**, an automated demographic fairness auditing pipeline measuring predictive disparities on computer vision benchmarks as the two-person fellowship capstone.

Built agentic AI and retrieval coursework including a **5-stage Text-to-SQL** pipeline (Planner -> Generator -> Validator -> Executor -> Summarizer), a FastAPI **RAG AI Assistant** (Qdrant, bounded tool calls), a **Verified Agentic Assistant** checking retrieved context and citations, and **Trustworthy AI Guardrails** (Pydantic schema, prompt-injection, PII, and groundedness checks against a golden evaluation set).

Implemented dual-track **MLOps** coursework for experiment tracking, model serving, data-drift monitoring, and scheduled regression evaluation using **MLflow**, **FastAPI**, **Docker**, **PostgreSQL**, **Evidently**, and **Airflow**.

Developed tabular, vision, and NLP coursework pipelines spanning **Telco Churn & CLV** (**XGBoost**, **LightGBM**, **SMOTE**, **SHAP**), multi-horizon time-series forecasting ensembles, **NEU Steel Defect CNN** and Vision Transformers, and customer-support **NER** and **LSTM** classifiers.

projects.title: BiasAperture — Computer Vision Demographic Fairness & Bias Audit
projects.subtitle: Fuse AI Fellowship Capstone Project
projects.summary: Diagnostic prediction-auditing framework measuring demographic parity and error-rate disparities across intersectional groups in computer vision.

bullets.text: Co-developed an automated prediction-auditing and reporting pipeline as a two-person fellowship capstone with Tisha Manandhar.

Audited classification performance across **126 demographic bins** on the FairFace benchmark (**97,698 images**), computing Disparate Impact Ratio, Demographic Parity Difference, and Equalized Odds with cohort-support diagnostics.
Engineered self-contained HTML and PDF report generation with confidence intervals and diagnostic disparity plots; matched model comparisons and statistical validation remain active work.

projects.title: SPARK — Two-Layer Edge-AI Fall Detection Wearable
projects.subtitle: Undergraduate Major Capstone Project
projects.summary: Embedded safety wearable combining kinematic acceleration gating with on-device neural confirmation and gateway explainability.

bullets.text: Project lead for ML modeling, gateway processing, and explainability in a four-person team; hardware and firmware have dedicated owners.
Trained leakage-free subject-stratified 1D-CNN fall-detection models on the SisFall benchmark (38 subjects, 38,420 windows), achieving **0.9185 AUC-ROC** and 87.81% sensitivity.

Quantized the model to an **18.5 KB INT8 CNN** footprint for ESP32-S3 deployment and built edge-gateway SHAP attribution; on-device hardware testing, BLE streaming, and volunteer cohort validation remain pending.

projects.title: STRANGLER-IPU — Ingress Processing Unit Architecture Research
projects.subtitle: Near-Memory Systems & Queueing Simulation
projects.summary: Architecture research investigating near-ingress data reduction to relieve host DRAM bandwidth contention under high-volume ingest.

bullets.text: Modeled decoupled front-end ingress offload over asymmetric CXL pooled-memory fabrics via SimPy discrete-event simulation (sweep_ipu_breakeven.py), observing **4.12x tail-latency reduction** and **68% host memory bus contention relief** in simulation (research prototype; no physical silicon).
Documented architectural assumptions, failure modes, and invariant boundaries in versioned RFCs and reproducible LaTeX technical reports.

projects.title: Win-Governor (NovaOptimizer) & Win-Vault — Windows Systems & Privacy Utilities
projects.subtitle: Native OS Kernel Memory & NTFS Security Tooling
